scope: Follow-up closes the remote OAuth mutation/local persistence failure boundary identified in validation.json; local HTTP fixtures only
supersedes_limit_in: validation.json: adapter deletion/status succeeds but local persistence fails

implementation.deletion: Resolve exact auth filename and original disabled state, download original JSON to memory before submitting DELETE; never mutate when a restorable snapshot cannot be acquired.
implementation.status: Resolve exact auth filename and original disabled value before PATCH.
implementation.commit_and_compensation: Hold reloadMu across adapter mutation, local commit, and compensation; set attempted before HTTP submission. Failed/ambiguous acknowledgement or local commit failure restores original file/status using an independent 15-second context, then verifies status and effective disk config.
implementation.local_disk: Confirm effective config still matches unchanged runtime after a failed save (including rename-before-fsync errors), restoring and rechecking when required.
implementation.cancellation: Check context after apply and before returning the configuration mutation callback; cancellation during post-apply catalog refresh cannot be converted to a successful warning.
implementation.runtime_parent: Compensation confirmation resolves runtime-only virtual auth rows by parent filename as well as public auth index.

error_contract.oauth_credential_change_rolled_back: Original credential/status and gateway configuration confirmed restored. Original operation failed.
error_contract.oauth_credential_rollback_incomplete: Restoration cannot be confirmed. Restore adapter connectivity/configuration write access and inspect both sides before retrying. Never claim recovery.

verified_cases: request cancellation after apply during catalog refresh
subsequent gateway call completes after successful rollback, or remains rejected for originally disabled source
limitations: No real provider grant was deleted, disabled, or restored.
If the external adapter or filesystem remains unavailable, bounded compensation can fail; the API explicitly returns oauth_credential_rollback_incomplete and requires state inspection after recovery.
Credential snapshots are memory-only; this is runtime compensation, not a durable cross-process crash transaction.
Direct out-of-band adapter file changes are outside the gateway configuration lock.
Connections deliberately disabled after removal or route invalidation require reviewed repair and explicit re-enable.
